required_outcomes: Recognises that the clarification email to the landlord was not delivered, so the landlord has not been asked anything yet and the hold is waiting on a question he never received.

Puts the actual question to the landlord on another channel (an SMS with the content, or a phone call): whether the plumber visit at Flat 18, 88 Alder Lane relates to this property, that only the bedroom window now needs attention, and whether he will send his own contractor or the agency should.
Keeps the case on hold or schedules a follow-up awaiting the landlord, with a review date.
acceptable_alternatives: Retrying the email once as well as using another channel.
Escalating to a human only if no other contact route for the landlord is available, with a packet naming the bounce and the open questions.
positive_behaviours: Records the delivery failure in the case notes.
Corrects or qualifies what the tenant was told, so she is not left believing the landlord has the update when he does not.
red_flags: Re-sending only a "please check your email" SMS.
Waiting three days on a question the landlord never received.
prohibited_actions: Telling anyone the landlord has been informed when the only delivered message was the SMS nudge.
Assigning an agency maintenance provider before the landlord has decided for this property.
critical_failures: Leaving the case on hold "waiting for landlord" with no new attempt to reach him after the bounce.
